draftsStartedNew: Set aside — you're on a fresh draft
draftsNoVersions: Versions appear as you keep writing
draftsSwitched: Switched drafts — the other one is set aside
draftsVersionRestoredBody: What you had is kept on its own branch in the version history.
draftsUndoDone: Undone — back to what you had
historyIntro: A version is saved every time you pause writing. Bringing one back never throws anything away.
historyEmptyBody: Start writing — a version is saved each time you pause.
historyCompare: Compared with what's in the form now
historySame: This matches what's in the form now.
historyOtherFields: {count, plural, one {Also changes # other field} other {Also changes # other fields}}
historyRestoreHint: Nothing gets deleted: what's in the form now stays on its own branch, so you can always switch back.
historyNowHint: This is what's in the form right now. Sharing or naming it saves it as a version.
historyBranchLegend: The coloured line leads to what's in your form. Grey lines are versions you went back from — they're all still here.
historyNamePlaceholder: e.g. Sent to Anna for review
historyNamed: Version named — it'll always be kept
historySharedWith: {others, plural, =0 {Shared with {name}} one {Shared with {name} and # other} other {Shared with {name} and # others}}
shareBody: The people you pick can read the version from {time} and leave comments. What you write after that isn't shared.
shareFootnote: They get a notification and can find it under My drafts. Attached files aren't included.
shareConfirm: {count, plural, one {Share with # person} other {Share with # people}}
shareDefaultName: {others, plural, =0 {Shared with {name}} one {Shared with {name} and # other} other {Shared with {name} and # others}}
shareDone: {others, plural, =0 {Shared with {name}} one {Shared with {name} and # other} other {Shared with {name} and # others}}
shareDoneBody: You'll get a notification when someone comments.

versionChange.title: Changed the title
versionChange.added: Added {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}
versionChange.removed: Removed {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}
versionChange.edited: Edited {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}

draftRestored: Picked up where you left off
draftFilesNotKept: Attached files aren't kept in drafts — add them again if you need them.
offerBody: From {time}. Restore them, or keep the saved version?
offerRemoteBody: A newer version of this draft was saved elsewhere {time}. Load it, or keep what's here?
readinessMissingBody: Tap a highlighted item to jump to it.
readinessReadyBody: Everything required is there. Dashed items are optional.
